project.name: Gimle Example: greeter-consumer
project.description: Companion to greeter-provider: a real, deployable Gimle module that looks up the provider's Greeter service over the fabric and calls it -- exercising ModuleContext#lookupService's actual cross-worker/cross-machine proxy + wire-codec path (both modules are TIER_2, a dedicated worker JVM each, guaranteeing they never share a worker and the lookup can never take the same-worker Class-identity shortcut). The lookup happens on a background virtual thread spawned from onStart, not inline: onStart runs synchronously on the worker's single control-channel receive loop, the same loop that delivers the CatalogUpdate messages service discovery depends on, so a hook blocking there while waiting for that same catalog to populate would deadlock against itself. Same requires-static/addReads story as greeter-provider -- see its own description.
